newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk energy minister to visit Egypt for gas talks.
newsitem.headline: Turk energy minister to visit Egypt for gas talks.

text.p: Turkish Energy Minister Recai Kutan will go to Egypt next week to hold talks on Turkey's possible purchase of natural gas, officials said on Wednesday.
They said Kutan, who will visit Cairo on November 12-14, would discuss buying gas from Egypt through either a pipeline under the Mediterranean or through tankers in liquefied natural gas (LNG) form.

Energy-hungry Turkey, trying to diversify its energy resources to lessen dependence on oil and coal, signed a memorandum of understanding with Iran in Ankara on Tuesday to get gas from Iran through a pipeline from 1998 under a 23-year, $23-billion deal.
The deal has been criticised by Turkey's NATO ally the United States, which opposes dealings with Iran because of its alleged nuclear arms programme and what Washington sees as support for terrorism.
